title: Scalar Subquery
description: Show each employee's name, salary, and how their salary compares to the department average. Include columns: name, department, salary, dept_avg_salary, and salary_diff (salary - dept_avg).
hints: Use a correlated scalar subquery in SELECT to compute AVG(salary) for the employee's department
The subquery needs a WHERE clause matching the department
Salary diff can be computed as salary - subquery_result
